verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that users can view past-month usage broken down by model and provider, bill usage to an organization, and bring their own provider key. None of these is a spending cap or a budget alert. A usage dashboard is an adjacent feature: it does not stop a runaway workload or warn about one, so there is no documented capability for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
